NHI-R1-SOURCE.purpose: The raw artifact is the dataset published by the National Health Insurance Administration.
checklist: Dataset landing page https://data.gov.tw/dataset/174450 lists 衛生福利部中央健康保險署 as provider.
Landing page license is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版; metadata license code is 1.
Artifact was fetched from an allowlisted info.nhi.gov.tw HTTPS resource URL discovered from metadata.
Attribution text is 資料提供機關：衛生福利部中央健康保險署.

NHI-R1-SCHEMA.purpose: The raw artifact matches the approved nhi-7-v1 schema and every source row is preserved.
checklist: Header has the seven approved columns in order.
Points are non-negative base-10 integers and are never converted to money.
Dates are strict Gregorian YYYYMMDD values.
29101231 stays raw with an inference flag and is never described as permanent.
Blank English names and notes stay blank; non-blank notes are preserved in full.
Quoted line breaks stay inside one record.
Codes from two to seven characters are accepted.

PUB-R1-OWNER.purpose: The owner authorizes this build to be served by the local MCP runtime.
PUB-R1-OWNER.excluded: Redistributing curated artifacts, including GitHub Releases, requires a separate approval.
checklist: Every official result carries provenance attribution and the license URL https://data.gov.tw/license.
Every official NHI result carries the note 非健保署官方服務，內容以健保署公告為準。

golden_cases.comparison: Compare values and locators with the raw artifact and the official NHI payment standard query service.

minor_examples: A note that differs from the official query service only by line breaks.
